title: chenopodium album subsp. pseudopulifolium
intro: Chenopodium album subsp. pseudopulifolium, commonly known as lamb's quarters, is a subspecies of the Chenopodium album plant. It is a plant in the amaranth family known for its edible leaves, stems, and seeds. The leaves of Chenopodium album subsp. pseudopulifolium have been reported to have various health benefits, including being rich in vitamins and minerals, and having antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
